investing_1h26.explanation: The ~$1.16bn 1H-2026 investing outflow is $1,062m acquisitions (10-Q MD&A: 'primarily for Dellner Couplers'; all paid in Q1-26) plus $108m capex, less $10m other. Dellner consideration $1,053m less $17m cash acquired = $1,036m (computed); the ~$26m balance is not itemised (no other 2026 acquisition is disclosed; Q1-26 deck shows 1 acquisition / $1.1bn 2026 YTD). Restricted cash (acquisition escrow) fell from $25m to $10m.
